title: Strings & Memory Scanning
description:
## Strings in Assembly
Strings are just arrays of bytes ending in 0 (null-terminated).

```asm
msg db 'Hello', 0
```

To process strings, you loop through memory one byte at a time:

```asm
mov rsi, msg
.loop:
    mov al, [rsi]
    cmp al, 0
    je .done
    ; do something with al
    inc rsi
    jmp .loop
.done:
```

## Assignment
Write a function `strlen` that takes a pointer to a string in `rdi` and returns its length in `rax`.

Count bytes until you hit the null terminator (0).

cmp rax, 7
